reason_summary: r1 was a pre-execution design draft with three defects found by the independent review; it was never run and is superseded by r2. All r1 bytes are kept unchanged as evidence of the unexecuted design defects.

A_third_arm_not_preregistered.problem: A slot with a null mechanism is not a pre-registered candidate; it does not freeze what will be run.
A_third_arm_not_preregistered.r2_fix: r2 freezes the third arm to the existing conservative_l2_guarded_rerank_v2 (mechanism_id set, is_new_mechanism=false) and pins its whole mechanism chain; no new mechanism is invented.

B_record_completeness_conflicts_with_hon.observed: success_gates.record_completeness == "all 2638 unique samples present and parseable"
B_record_completeness_conflicts_with_hon.problem: Demanding that all 2638 outputs be parseable contradicts the honest parse contract: even Dense emits unparseable outputs, so a 100% parse gate can only be passed by aliasing the boolean correctness field.
B_record_completeness_conflicts_with_hon.r2_fix: r2 record completeness requires only 2638 unique complete output records; parsed_answer may be null, parse failures count as wrong and are reported as success/failure counts and rates, and there is no 100% parse gate.

C_auditor_model_flag_dropped.observed: the auditor CLI parsed --model but never forwarded it to audit(); verify_processor always opened DEFAULT_MODEL.
C_auditor_model_flag_dropped.problem: The audit report could not prove which processor path produced the 2638/2638 grid re-derivation, so the audit was not fully self-describing.
C_auditor_model_flag_dropped.r2_fix: audit() now takes an explicit model_path, main() forwards --model, the processor is opened only from that path, and the report records the actual processor model path.

auditor_pin_now_stale.note: Because the auditor was corrected, the r1 config's auditor pin no longer matches the on-disk auditor. r1 is superseded and must not be re-generated or executed; the re-audit uses the corrected auditor and is recorded separately.

r1_self_test_status.cause: the pinned r1 auditor (45dcd049) is stale after the deliberate defect-C fix; every other r1 assertion still holds
r1_self_test_status.interpretation: this expected failure is positive evidence that the r1 preregistration is superseded and cannot be executed; it is not a regression in the r2 or corrected-auditor focused tests

scoping: CPU-only, read-only. No GPU, no model weights, no network, no training, no dependency installation. The edge576 manifest, builder, source full manifest, model identity and metric_v2 were not modified.
